g.text: When X2 reports 'done', the executor decrements the

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: counter of each successor. B2 hits 0 and is sent to AGV

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: B. Nothing in this loop reads a clock.

g.text: This nominal run needs 8 s although the plan had 5 steps: an ADG lets a robot enter a vertex only after the previous robot's move out of it has completed, so the plan's 'following' moves become sequential. How much that costs in practice depends on how

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: What the executor knows at t = 3.5 s

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Nominal run of the final ADG (every action 1 s). An action is dispatched when its count of unfinished predecessors reaches 0; robots report completion; that is the whole protocol.
